notes_for_editor: Record agency '17N' is a township, range and section string, not an agency (see corrections). Record coordinates lie within about 30 m of the NGS station GF0866 position (36 06 23.95 N, 093 56 39.41 W). The 1971 description names a private owner; the story leaves the name out. No build date, builder, staffing, fires or present status appears in the Central US page, the NGS datasheet or the Encyclopedia of Arkansas. Mindat, TopoZone and Mapcarta appeared only as search results (not read); they name the feature and its elevation but add no history. A 2023 Arkansas Online headline seen in search results gives 17 towers remaining, against the Encyclopedia's 46 for 2023; not used. Worth checking Arkansas Forestry Commission or Washington County historical records for build date and fate. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the Central US Lookouts page gives no access advice, so the story no longer says visitors should keep off the site or avoid climbing the tower; the 'northwest leg' wording is now backed by its own evidence line.
